reason: Every provider chat turn without an explicit maximum was capped at 2,048 output tokens: resolve_context_limits defaulted to min(DEFAULT_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, caps) and the SessionsPage never sends max_output_tokens. Reasoning models (DeepSeek v4.x, GLM 5.x, gpt-5, Claude) spend thinking from that same allowance, so routing steps were cut off mid-call and synthesis returned reasoning only until bounded recovery gave up ('no operator-facing answer after bounded recovery'). The mission specialists had the same flat 2,048 at every construction site (missions, automation and browser tool missions, the CLI). When the model's output limit is known (catalog descriptor, verified OpenRouter route limits, the built-in known-model table, or the profile's declared maximum) the default is now min(that limit, 32,000, window // 4), never below the old allowance; unknown output and the 8,192 fallback window keep 2,048, and an explicit request maximum still wins. The window // 4 bound keeps input capacity at no less than three quarters of the window, the share the 2,048-of-8,192 fallback already left, so compaction triggers earlier instead of pre-flight refusing. Missions use a new default_output_tokens helper that resolves the stored profile and keeps a smaller mission token budget as the bound. tests/v3/test_model_output_budget.py covers the rule, the chat request, compaction instead of pre-flight failure, each mission construction site and the CLI (all 19 cases fail on main); test_hosted_provider_uses_published_limits_without_a_catalog is updated from 2,048 to 32,000. The other selected node ids directly exercise resolve_context_limits, the output-recovery budget and the analysis mission and CLI construction paths.
exclusions: Scoped per the CI-scoping rule: whole existing files are not listed; test_context.py, test_chat.py, test_chat_tool_loop.py, test_chat_goals.py, test_chat_api.py, test_chat_subagents.py, test_missions.py, test_orchestration.py, test_specialist_tool_batches.py and test_cli.py were run locally (all pass) and are reported in the PR body. No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: the area:core-api real-Core journeys do not observe the output allowance a provider request carries; the Python tests drive resolve_context_limits, ChatService.prepare and each specialist construction directly. No full suites.
